referenceFunction.generalComment: Sugar refinery with a production capacity of 200 kt sugar per year (production period of 100-180 days/year, depending on the feedstock). Life time is taken as 50 years. Equivalent feed capacities vary from 1’300 kt/yr for sugar beets to 1’650 kt/yr for sugarcane.; UUID: c397af8b-c383-3730-86b5-79eaaf77789a
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This process includes land use and occupation, buildings and facilities of a typical sugar refinery in the global context. Energy use for construction and related emissions and/or waste effluents are not included.
referenceFunction.name: Sugar refinery

technology.text: Technology is of a standard sugar refinery, including washing of the feedstock, juice extraction, purification and crystallisation. Juice extraction is performed by diffusion.

representativeness.productionVolume: World production of sugar was 130 Mt in 2000
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data was adapted from the ethanol fermentation plant dataset.
